explication: FlashMLA is a PyTorch-facing library of hardware-optimized attention kernels for NVIDIA GPUs and Huawei Ascend NPUs. The principal workflow is to pass query, KV-cache, and sparse-index tensors through the Python interface into a native API, which dispatches supported sparse prefill or decoding work to a device kernel and returns attention results. Separate capabilities include fused norm/RoPE/attention/cast, dense prefill and backward attention, and split-KV decode scheduling and combination. The graph reflects documented capabilities and visible source references; some native entry points and kernel implementations were not excerpted, so their links are documented or left unverified.
